criteria.statement: System discovery projection publishes a service-key-signed NIP-65 kind 10002 relay preference event.
The service-authored 10002 marks ContextVM request/read relays with read and service publish/backfill relays with write, without bleeding browser-only relays into the advisory list.
A 10002 publish attempt with zero relay acceptances is returned as a projection failure instead of being treated as successful advisory publication.
Docs state that service NIP-65 10002 is advisory wider-Nostr routing metadata and does not replace ContextVM discovery plus NIP-51 30002 bootstrap relay sets.
